# Uyuni audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording that its author released into the public domain.
No attribution is required for any of them; the authors are credited here with thanks.
`tools/uyuni-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set uyuni` rebuilds them.

## Files

- `wind.mp3` is cut from "Wind blowing into some cactus spine, on the top of the mountain, in the desert of Atacama (Chile)." by felix.blume, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/felix.blume/sounds/156414/.
